stops.title: Amalfi town + Duomo
stops.desc: Coffee on the stepped cathedral square, a look into the Arab-Norman cloister; before the crowd ferries arrive, the town is yours.

stops.title: Ferry to Positano
stops.desc: Approaching from the sea is the only right way to see Positano: the pastel houses unfold like a painting hung on the cliff.

stops.title: Lunch + Fornillo beach
stops.desc: Walk from the main beach's show to Fornillo's calm; lunch by the water, feet in the sand.

stops.title: Climb to Ravello
stops.desc: By bus to the town in the clouds: from Villa Cimbrone's Terrace of Infinity, the world lies at your feet.

stops.title: Sunset in Atrani
stops.desc: The tiny square next door to Amalfi is an Italy exempt from tourism; find a table under the arch.

stops.title: Dinner — with lemons
stops.desc: Pasta al limone or scialatielli ai frutti di mare, closing with limoncello — from the producer.

stops.title: Breakfast in Jordaan
stops.desc: Start the day with apple pie at Winkel 43 — yes, pie for breakfast, you're here.

stops.title: 9 Straatjes + Canal Belt walk
stops.desc: From the Nine Streets south along Prinsengracht; don't rush, stop on the bridges.

stops.title: Lunch at Albert Cuypmarkt
stops.desc: A warm stroopwafel, fresh haring, or whatever calls you. Standing up, market style.

stops.title: Rijksmuseum or Van Gogh
stops.desc: Don't cram both into one day. Pick one and take your time. Book the ticket ahead.

stops.title: Borrel at a bruin café
stops.desc: Bitterballen + beer. The most Dutch hour of the day.

stops.title: Canalside at sunset
stops.desc: Grab a bottle of something from a market, sit on the canal edge, let your feet dangle. The whole day was for this.

stops.title: Anıtkabir & War of Independence
stops.desc: Walk the majestic Lion Road, witness the ceremonial guard change, and pay respects at the Mausoleum of Atatürk.

stops.title: Artisan Döner & Anatolian Civilizations
stops.desc: Savor authentic oak-fired leaf doner in Ulus before exploring the world-famous Hittite sun discs at the museum.

stops.title: Ankara Castle & Hamamönü Mansions
stops.desc: Climb fortress ramparts for a 360-degree vista, browse copper shops, and drink Turkish coffee brewed on hot sand in Hamamönü.

stops.title: Swan Park & Tunalı Promenade
stops.desc: Feed the swans at Kuğulu Park with crunchy Ankara simit, then browse boutiques along leafy Tunalı Hilmi Street.

stops.title: Legendary Aspava Dinner
stops.desc: Feast on sauced SSK durum wraps surrounded by complimentary spiced fries, salad, cacik, and hot semolina halva.

stops.title: Palais de l'Île & Pont Perrière
stops.desc: Photograph the 12th-century stone prison ship rising from the Thiou canal in the morning light.

stops.title: Château d'Annecy & Arcaded Lanes
stops.desc: Climb up the cobblestone ramp to the castle museum and wander along arcaded Rue Sainte-Claire.

stops.title: Savoyard Lunch at Le Fréti
stops.desc: Indulge in bubbling Tartiflette au Reblochon or traditional cheese fondue with cured Savoie ham.

stops.title: Pont des Amours & Jardins de l'Europe
stops.desc: Walk across the romantic wrought-iron bridge and stroll among century-old California redwoods.

stops.title: Lake Cruise or Pedal-Boat Rental
stops.desc: Rent a pedal-boat from Le Pâquier or board a scenic lake cruise to admire the turquoise waters against Alpine cliffs.

stops.title: Artisanal Ice Cream at Glacier des Alpes
stops.desc: Choose wild blueberry or lavender honey gelato while sitting on the stone canal quays.

stops.title: A Kaleiçi morning
stops.desc: Enter by Hadrian's Gate, lose yourself around the Broken Minaret and the mansion lanes; descend to the marina for the first tea above the ha...

stops.title: The Antalya Museum or Perge
stops.desc: Either face Rome in the museum's statue halls, or drive half an hour and walk Perge's colonnaded avenue: the morning cool belongs to history...

stops.title: A piyaz + köfte lunch
stops.desc: Tahini piyaz, şiş köfte and hibeş at a tradesmen's lokanta: Antalya's signature table. Fresh-squeezed orange juice on top.

stops.title: The sea shift
stops.desc: A mountain-view swim at Konyaaltı or city-centre cool in Mermerli's stairway cove: the afternoon belongs to the water.

stops.title: The Karaalioğlu sunset
stops.desc: Walk the cliff park and take your place at the Hıdırlık Tower: as the sun drops behind the Beydağları, the gulf turns to gold.

stops.title: Evening in Kaleiçi
stops.desc: Dinner in a courtyard, then a night walk above the marina: lamplight on stone lanes, boat lights on the water — a Mediterranean day closes l...

stops.title: Acropolis — at the gates' opening
stops.desc: See the Parthenon in morning light, without the crowds; greet the caryatids of the Erechtheion.

stops.title: The Acropolis Museum
stops.desc: Glass floors and the Parthenon frieze; the story of what you saw on the hill completes itself here.

stops.title: Plaka + Anafiotika
stops.desc: Lunch in a quiet corner of Plaka, then lose yourself in Anafiotika's whitewashed passages.

stops.title: Ancient Agora + Monastiraki
stops.desc: From the shade of the Temple of Hephaistos to the noise of the flea market: two thousand years in a fifteen-minute walk.

stops.title: Lycabettus sunset
stops.desc: Funicular to the top; a bird's-eye farewell to the Acropolis as the city turns crimson.

stops.title: Taverna night in Psiri
stops.desc: Meze, paidakia, house wine; if live music starts, don't resist the kefi.

stops.title: Southern breakfast
stops.desc: Open the day with biscuits, eggs and grits: the fuel station of a Southern morning. Large coffee — there's much walking today.

stops.title: MLK National Historical Park
stops.desc: The birth home, Ebenezer Baptist Church and the tomb: walk the civil rights legacy in morning calm. The visitor center is free.

stops.title: Lunch at Sweet Auburn market
stops.desc: Soul food at the century-old market stalls: take your tray and eat inside history.

stops.title: The BeltLine walk
stops.desc: Enter the Eastside Trail from O4W Park: street art, joggers and the Krog Tunnel detour on the way to Ponce City Market.

stops.title: The Ponce City rooftop
stops.desc: Snack in the food hall, then the mini amusement park and the view up top: Atlanta's transformation story in one building.

stops.title: Lemon pepper evening
stops.desc: Lemon pepper wet at a wing hall, sweet tea alongside: close with the night skyline from Jackson Street Bridge.

stops.title: Grand Palace and Wat Pho
stops.desc: See the Emerald Buddha at gate opening, then Wat Pho's 46-meter Reclining Buddha: two classics in the morning cool. Shoulders and knees cove...

stops.title: Across the river to Wat Arun
stops.desc: Cross from the pier: approach the porcelain-clad spire of the Temple of Dawn. The river breeze is the cure for midday heat.

stops.title: Stall lunch
stops.desc: Pad thai or a noodle bowl around Tha Tien: find the local queue, take a plastic stool. Don't forget to say 'aroi!'

stops.title: Jim Thompson House and an AC break
stops.desc: A half-hour guided tour of the teak house, then cold air and iced Thai tea in Siam's malls: outsmart the afternoon heat.

stops.title: Sunset boat or rooftop bar
stops.desc: Watch the river lights from an orange-flag boat out of Sathorn, or see the city ignite from a rooftop bar — mind the dress code.

stops.title: Yaowarat night
stops.desc: A stall crawl under Chinatown's neon: five stops, five plates. Close with mango sticky rice — a Bangkok day ends sweet.

stops.title: Sagrada Família
stops.desc: Take the first slot: the light through the stained glass is at its best in the morning, and the crowds haven't arrived. Tickets weeks ahead!

stops.title: Modernisme walk in Eixample
stops.desc: Along Passeig de Gràcia past Casa Batlló and La Pedrera; even without going in, the façades are a free feast.

stops.title: Menu del Día
stops.desc: Turn one street off the tourist track and have the daily menu: two courses + drink + dessert, the best value in the city.

stops.title: Get lost in Barri Gòtic, no GPS
stops.desc: The cathedral, Plaça Sant Felip Neri, narrow medieval lanes. Map off, eyes open.

stops.title: Seaside at Barceloneta
stops.desc: Walk the shoreline, dip your feet, grab a drink from a chiringuito.

stops.title: Pinchos crawl on Carrer de Blai
stops.desc: Bar to bar, one or two pinchos and a glass at each. The Catalan finale to the evening.

stops.title: Bari Vecchia morning
stops.desc: Get lost in the lanes: washing lines, saints' corners, doorstep conversations. The city at its most honest.

stops.title: Basilica di San Nicola
stops.desc: The Romanesque basilica holding Santa Claus's (Saint Nicholas's) bones; the crypt is where Catholic and Orthodox pilgrims meet.

stops.title: Strada delle Orecchiette
stops.desc: Watch the nonnas roll pasta at their doors on Arco Basso; buy fresh orecchiette from the stall.

stops.title: Lunch — focaccia or raw sea
stops.desc: Hot focaccia barese from Panificio Fiore, or crudo courage by the harbour; both are Bari classics.

stops.title: Lungomare walk
stops.desc: Walk against the sea on one of Italy's longest waterfronts, as far as the Margherita Theatre.

stops.title: Dinner — orecchiette con cime di rapa
stops.desc: The city's signature pasta at a trattoria + Primitivo wine; close with a pasticciotto.

stops.title: Pekara breakfast
stops.desc: Hot burek from the bakery counter and drinkable yoghurt: the basic equation of a Belgrade morning. Standing, or on a park bench.

stops.title: Knez Mihailova and Republic Square
stops.desc: The pedestrian street's facades, passages and bookshops: a warm-up walk through the city's salon. Coffee break on the Dorćol side.

stops.title: Exploring Kalemegdan
stops.desc: Ramparts, gates, the Pobednik statue and the meeting of two rivers: tour the fortress without hurry — the military museum is a bonus for ent...

stops.title: Kafana lunch
stops.desc: Karađorđeva schnitzel or pljeskavica with šopska salad: the portions serious, the table yours. A small rakija to close.

stops.title: St. Sava and the crypt
stops.desc: Stand beneath the vast dome, then descend below ground: the golden-mosaic crypt is the city's brightest surprise.

stops.title: Skadarlija and the night
stops.desc: Dinner on the bohemian lane with accordion and rakija; if you have strength left, stretch the night on a Sava splav — a Belgrade night doesn...

stops.title: Brandenburg Gate + Holocaust Memorial
stops.desc: Early, before the crowds. Walk between the two monuments and feel two centuries of the city.

stops.title: Reichstag dome or Museum Island
stops.desc: Register free in advance for the Reichstag; or pick one museum on Museum Island — never attempt all of them.

stops.title: Currywurst or döner break
stops.desc: Currywurst standing at Curry 36, or the gemüse kebap if the queue seems worth it. This is Berlin street food.

stops.title: Wall Memorial on Bernauer Straße
stops.desc: The real story of the Wall: the border strip, escape tunnels, the death strip. Checkpoint Charlie, but genuine.

stops.title: Sunset at Tempelhofer Feld
stops.desc: Walk the old runway, rent a bike, or lie on the grass. Berlin freedom at its most physical.

stops.title: Kreuzberg evening
stops.desc: A Kneipe, then a bar, a Späti beer on the way between. Then wherever the night goes.

stops.title: The marina and morning lanes
stops.desc: A simit-and-tea breakfast on the quay, a bougainvillea tour of the white lanes: a Bodrum morning is calm and photogenic.

stops.title: The castle and the Underwater Museum
stops.desc: Tour the Museum of Underwater Archaeology in the castle between the two bays: meet the glass-wreck hall and the Carian princess.

stops.title: A çökertme lunch
stops.desc: Çökertme kebab at the lokanta the locals recommend: potatoes crisp, yoghurt cold, fillet thin — the Bodrum signature.

stops.title: The bay shift — Bitez
stops.desc: Dolmuş to Bitez: walk down through the mandarin orchards to the shallow bay and give the afternoon to the sea.

stops.title: The Gümüşlük sunset
stops.desc: Take your quay table: as the sun sinks behind Rabbit Island, let your fish arrive — the peninsula's most famous hour.

stops.title: Night in the centre
stops.desc: A marina walk on return, a warm lokma from the cart for the finale: whether the night continues on Bar Street or the quiet quay is your call...

stops.title: Piazza Maggiore + San Petronio
stops.desc: An espresso standing at the corner of the square, then into San Petronio with its famously unfinished façade.

stops.title: Quadrilatero wander
stops.desc: Medieval market lanes: salumeria windows, the scent of mortadella, Mercato di Mezzo. Save room for lunch.

stops.title: Tagliatelle al ragù
stops.desc: Eat the pasta of your life at a trattoria. Lunch is the main event; that is how Bologna works.

stops.title: Santo Stefano + Finestrella
stops.desc: Explore the seven-church complex, then peek through the little window on Via Piella at the hidden canal.

stops.title: Asinelli Tower or San Luca
stops.desc: 498 steps for the rooftop view; or walk under the porticoes toward San Luca instead.

stops.title: Evening on Via del Pratello
stops.desc: Aperitivo on the students' and locals' street, then an osteria. At Osteria del Sole: wine, plus the salumi you brought yourself.

stops.title: Place de la Bourse & Miroir d'Eau
stops.desc: Begin at the magnificent 18th-century royal square and photograph its golden reflection in the giant shallow water mirror.

stops.title: Grand Théâtre & Triangle d'Or
stops.desc: Admire the 12 Corinthian columns of Victor Louis' opera house and browse the elegant boutiques of the Golden Triangle.

stops.title: Canelé Tasting at Baillardran
stops.desc: Pick up warm, caramelized rum-vanilla Canelés fresh from copper molds.

stops.title: Lunch at Marché des Capucins
stops.desc: Join the locals for fresh Arcachon oysters, crusty bread, and chilled white wine at Chez Jean-Mi.

stops.title: Cité du Vin Interactive Museum
stops.desc: Take tram B to the futuristic wine museum and enjoy an immersive sensory journey through global wine history, ending with a rooftop glass on...

stops.title: Garonne River Promenade & Pont de Pierre
stops.desc: Stroll down the river quays or cross the 17-arch Napoleon bridge into La Bastide for sunset views over the neoclassical skyline.

stops.title: Bistro Dinner in Saint-Pierre
stops.desc: Dine on Entrecôte à la Bordelaise and local red wine in the candlelit squares of historic Saint-Pierre.

stops.title: Beacon Hill and Acorn Street
stops.desc: A morning walk in the gaslit streets: shoot Acorn Street while it's still empty, then descend to the Common.

stops.title: Freedom Trail — first half
stops.desc: Start at the Common: the State House, the burying grounds, the Old State House and the massacre site. The red line is your guide.

stops.title: Chowder break
stops.desc: Clam chowder with oyster crackers by the harbor: in a bread bowl if it's cold. Don't forget to say 'wicked good'.

stops.title: North End and Old North Church
stops.desc: Through the Italian quarter's narrow lanes onto Paul Revere's route: the church of the two lanterns and the historic house.

stops.title: Ferry to Charlestown
stops.desc: From Long Wharf by boat to the USS Constitution: the world's oldest floating warship and the Bunker Hill obelisk.

stops.title: Cannoli and a pub finale
stops.desc: Return to the North End: pick your side in the cannoli duel, then close the evening with a local beer in a storied pub.

stops.title: Marktplatz & Roland Statue
stops.desc: Start in the historic market square before the 1404 Roland statue and UNESCO Gothic Rathaus. Touch the donkey's hooves on the Town Musicians...

stops.title: Bremer Loch & St. Peter's Cathedral
stops.desc: Drop a coin in the bronze sidewalk hole to hear animal cries, then explore the twin-towered Romanesque-Gothic St. Petri Dom.

stops.title: Böttcherstraße & Glockenspiel
stops.desc: Stroll down the Brick Expressionist alley and hear the 30 Meissen porcelain bells chime at noon.

stops.title: Historic Lunch at Bremer Ratskeller
stops.desc: Descend into the 1405 Gothic vaults for authentic Labskaus or Knipp alongside fine German cask wine.

stops.title: Fairytale Schnoor Quarter
stops.desc: Wander among 15th-century miniature houses, take photos along Katzengang, and stop for tea and Kluten pastries.

stops.title: Riverside Evening at Schlachte Promenade
stops.desc: Walk down to the Weser banks to watch the sunset over historic tall ships with a chilled glass of fresh local beer.

stops.title: The empty squares
stops.desc: The Markt and the Burg before the tourists: the belfry, the guild façades and the cobbles are yours alone. Drink your coffee at the edge of ...

stops.title: Canal boat + Rozenhoedkaai
stops.desc: A boat tour on one of the first departures, then the classic postcard shot from the quay; don't forget to greet the swans.

stops.title: A frietkot stop and the Madonna
stops.desc: Frites in a cone for a standing lunch; then Michelangelo's Bruges Madonna at Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk — five minutes of silence is enough.

stops.title: Begijnhof and Minnewater
stops.desc: A quiet loop of the white courtyard, then willow shade beside the Lake of Love: the city's pulse slows down here.

stops.title: From the Groenerei to Sint-Anna
stops.desc: Walk the loveliest stretch of canal into the calm quarter and on to the windmills: the crowds are already behind you.

stops.title: Stoofvlees + a beer to close
stops.desc: Beer-braised stew at a neighbourhood tavern, then a quadrupel in a historic beer café: a Bourgondisch ending.

stops.title: The Grand Place, empty
stops.desc: See the gilded guild houses in morning light; drink your coffee at the edge of the deserted square. Stop by Manneken Pis, smile at his size,...

stops.title: Mont des Arts + Magritte
stops.desc: The city view from the garden terrace, then a dose of surrealism at the Magritte Museum: 'This is not a pipe' — but this is definitely Bruss...

stops.title: Lunch at Sainte-Catherine
stops.desc: A mussel pot on the old fish market square (if in season) or a seafood bar counter; alternative: a frietkot cone on a bench on the square.

stops.title: The Sablon and down into the Marolles
stops.desc: Fill a box at the master chocolatiers on the Sablon and scan the antique shop windows; then descend into the Marolles and rummage the bric-a...

stops.title: The MIM rooftop or the arch terrace
stops.desc: A sunset coffee at the rooftop café of the Old England building; if you have energy left, climb the Cinquantenaire arch and gather the city ...

stops.title: An estaminet to close
stops.desc: Carbonnade or stoemp at a wooden-tabled tavern, with a Trappist in its own glass; make the second beer a gueuze — you drink to Brussels.

stops.title: A castle morning
stops.desc: Funicular up to Buda Castle: look across to Parliament from the Fisherman's Bastion turrets and see the Mátyás Church roof tiles in morning ...

stops.title: The Chain Bridge and the basilica
stops.desc: Cross the bridge on foot into Pest; climb to St Stephen's dome terrace or catch your breath at a square café.

stops.title: Lunch in the market hall
stops.desc: Lángos or gulyás on the Great Market's upper floor; paprika and Tokaji shopping below — the gift list ends in one building.

stops.title: Széchenyi steam
stops.desc: The M1 metro via Hősök tere to the baths: the hot-cold cycle in the yellow palace's outdoor pool, chess-watching allowed.

stops.title: Andrássy and a kávéház break
stops.desc: Back along the boulevard: the Opera façade, the arcades, and Dobos torte + coffee in a historic coffeehouse — an imperial late afternoon.

stops.title: Night: lights and a ruin bar
stops.desc: A lit-Parliament loop on tram 2, then a ruin bar night in District VII: old armchairs, odd objects, long conversation.

stops.title: Stari Grad, empty
stops.desc: Stone lanes, the Citadela and the walls walk in the morning cool: before the tour groups arrive, the Old Town is yours. Start with a coffee ...

stops.title: The Mogren path and a swim
stops.desc: Stop at the Ballerina statue, take the rocky path down to Mogren; pass through the tunnel to the second cove and take the day's first swim.

stops.title: Lunch at a konoba
stops.desc: Back to the harbour: riblja čorba + grilled fish, or crni rižoto. Cold white wine alongside, boats for a view.

stops.title: The Sveti Nikola boat
stops.desc: Ten minutes from the harbour to 'Hawaii': swim off the pebble cove and watch Budva's silhouette from across the water. Ice cream on the prom...

stops.title: The Sveti Stefan view
stops.desc: Minibus to the hairpin stop: the postcard island turns to gold in the sunset light. Walk down to Pržno for a glass by the water — the rivier...

stops.title: An Old Town evening
stops.desc: Dinner inside the walls, then square concerts or the bars under the ramparts: the night doesn't end early in Budva — you decide.

stops.title: Breakfast at Forville market
stops.desc: Fruit from the stalls, something from the bakery, espresso standing up; Cannes without make-up lives under this roof.

stops.title: Climb Le Suquet
stops.desc: Up the old quarter's narrow lanes to Notre-Dame d'Espérance: the bay, the islands and the tiled roofs at your feet.

stops.title: Ferry to Île Sainte-Marguerite
stops.desc: Walk the pine and eucalyptus forest, see the fort of the Man in the Iron Mask; the paths drop to the sea.

stops.title: The Croisette walk
stops.desc: Back on shore, walk the boulevard end to end: the Palais steps, the handprints, the beaches. Watching is free.

stops.title: Rue d'Antibes + Meynadier
stops.desc: Windows and boutiques; shop here for the evening's cheese, wine and tarte.

stops.title: Dinner in Le Suquet
stops.desc: Fish or bouillabaisse at the small restaurants on the hillside; the harbour lights below.

stops.title: La Pescheria
stops.desc: Shouting vendors, swordfish heads, the smell of ice and lemon: the Mediterranean's most theatrical market peaks early.

stops.title: Granita e brioche breakfast
stops.desc: Almond granita + warm brioche: Sicily's breakfast constitution. Summer or winter, no difference.

stops.title: Piazza del Duomo + the elephant
stops.desc: The lava-stone elephant (u Liotru) is the city's talisman; visit Bellini's tomb in the cathedral.

stops.title: Via Crociferi + Via Etnea
stops.desc: From the street of baroque churches to the city's spine: windows, courtyards, and Etna always on the horizon.

stops.title: Lunch — pasta alla Norma
stops.desc: The pasta named after Bellini's opera tastes different in its birthplace; an Etna white alongside.

stops.title: Aci Trezza late afternoon
stops.desc: The seafront opposite the rocks the Cyclops threw; granita or aperitivo at sunset, dinner back in Catania.

stops.title: Lakeside + Jet d'Eau
stops.desc: From the English Garden past the flower clock to the 140-metre fountain; in morning light the lake is a mirror.

stops.title: Old Town + St-Pierre
stops.desc: Cobbled lanes, the lake view from the cathedral tower, and the world's longest wooden bench on the Treille.

stops.title: Lunch at Halles de Rive
stops.desc: Cheese, charcuterie and fresh pasta at the covered market's stalls; where locals actually lunch.

stops.title: The streets of Carouge
stops.desc: Geneva's Greenwich Village: Sardinian-style courtyards, artisan shops, quiet cafés.

stops.title: Bains des Pâquis
stops.desc: Swim from the pier in the middle of the lake, or just sit; sunset here is democratic — the same view for everyone.

stops.title: Pâquis evening
stops.desc: World kitchens in the city's most colourful quarter — or, if it's winter, fondue by a stone wall.

stops.title: Alacati morning
stops.desc: Walk the stone streets while they're empty: shutters open, warm bread scents the air. Stretch the courtyard breakfast long — hurrying is for...

stops.title: Cove shift — Altinkum
stops.desc: First swim of the day in white sand and transparent shallows: morning is Altinkum's mirror hour.

stops.title: Kumru break
stops.desc: Post-beach kumru eaten standing: the sesame bread warm, the cheese melted. Cold ayran on the side — a Cesme classic.

stops.title: Cesme center and the castle
stops.desc: A marina stroll, gulf views from the castle walls, and a mastic ice cream break in the bazaar.

stops.title: Dalyan sunset
stops.desc: Claim a table on the canal quay: order the day's fish as the boats come home — the imbat's coolness comes with the table.

stops.title: Night in Alacati
stops.desc: Return to the stone streets: tables set out on the lanes, bougainvillea in the lamplight. Close with mastic pudding — a peninsula day ends s...

stops.title: Little Venice — empty
stops.desc: Start from the Saint-Pierre bridge and walk the canal: before the tourists, the town belongs to you and the bakers.

stops.title: Bakery breakfast + old town
stops.desc: Coffee with a bretzel or kugelhopf; then a heads-up walk past the façades of the Maison des Têtes and the Pfister House.

stops.title: Unterlinden Museum
stops.desc: Give the Isenheim Altarpiece two hours; breathe in the convent courtyard. This is Colmar's one world-class 'must'.

stops.title: Lunch at the Marché Couvert
stops.desc: A cheese-and-charcuterie plate or a tart from the market hall; eat on the rear terrace over the canal.

stops.title: Eguisheim escape
stops.desc: A 10-minute hop to the circular village: walk its concentric lanes, taste a Riesling at a producer, climb to the Three Towers.

stops.title: Winstub evening
stops.desc: Back in Colmar: choucroute or flammekueche under wood panelling, Edelzwicker by the jug. Santé!

stops.title: Morning Serenity at Mezquita-Cathedral
stops.desc: Enter through the Orange Courtyard (Patio de los Naranjos) and stroll among 856 two-tiered arches in tranquil morning light.

stops.title: Calleja de las Flores & Judería
stops.desc: Photograph the blue flowerpots, visit the 14th-century synagogue, and wander bougainvillea-draped alleys.

stops.title: Salmorejo Lunch at a Historic Tavern
stops.desc: Enjoy velvety Salmorejo, crispy Flamenquín, and a glass of chilled Montilla-Moriles wine.

stops.title: Alcázar de los Reyes Cristianos
stops.desc: Explore fountain terraces, cypress avenues, and take in Guadalquivir views from the fortress towers.

stops.title: Roman Bridge & Calahorra Tower
stops.desc: Stroll the 2,000-year-old stone bridge and watch the sunset illuminate the Mezquita skyline.

stops.title: Tavern Evening at Plaza del Potro
stops.desc: Savor honey-drizzled eggplant, Rabo de Toro stew, and traditional Pastel Cordobés in a historic inn.

stops.title: Breakfast taco morning
stops.desc: Chorizo tacos and coffee from a taquería counter: start the day Texas style.

stops.title: Dealey Plaza and the Sixth Floor Museum
stops.desc: Enter with your timed ticket: history stands at the window. Walk the plaza and the X mark with respect.

stops.title: Pioneer Plaza and a Downtown walk
stops.desc: Pass through the bronze herd with Reunion Tower behind: the classic frames of the Dallas skyline.

stops.desc: Start the day with a kanelsnegl and coffee, and shoot Nyhavn's colourful façades before the crowds; the quay is yours alone in the morning.

stops.title: A palace loop by bike
stops.desc: Pedal a rental bike from Amalienborg to Kastellet; stop if you catch the changing of the guard, greet the Little Mermaid in 30 seconds, carr...

stops.title: Lunch at Torvehallerne
stops.desc: Sit at a smørrebrød counter in the glass-roofed market: herring, shrimp, one snaps — the Danish lunch in summary.

stops.title: The Christianshavn canals
stops.desc: Walk the canalside, look at the boats, and if you have the nerve climb the twisted spire of Vor Frelsers: an external staircase, a city pano...

stops.title: Harbour life at Islands Brygge
stops.desc: Jump in if it's summer; if not, sit on the waterfront steps: sun, grass and half the city sitting with something in hand — Copenhagen's favo...

stops.title: An evening in Kødbyen
stops.desc: Dinner and bars in the old meatpacking district: one good plate, then skål at a micro beer bar. If the Tivoli lights are still on, close the...

stops.title: Old Venetian Fortress & Lighthouse
stops.desc: Cross the moat bridge into the 15th-century sea citadel and climb to the lighthouse for views of the Old Town.

stops.title: Liston Arcades & Spianada Square
stops.desc: Stroll beneath the Napoleonic lanterns and sip a cold iced frappe or fresh ginger beer (Tsitsibira).

stops.title: Campiello Quarter & St. Spyridon Church
stops.desc: Wander through the narrow laundry-strung alleys and pay respects to the island's patron saint.

stops.title: Venetian Lunch at Rex Restaurant
stops.desc: Taste authentic beef Sofrito in garlic-wine sauce or rooster Pastitsada on a pedestrian lane.

stops.title: Drive to Paleokastritsa Monastery
stops.desc: Visit the 13th-century clifftop monastery and take in breathtaking vistas over twin emerald bays.

stops.title: Sea Cave Boat Tour & Swimming
stops.desc: Board a small wooden boat into the luminous Blue Eye cave, then swim in the crystal-clear waters.

stops.title: Sunset Cocktail at Bella Vista
stops.desc: Head up to the village of Lakones (the 'Balcony of the Ionian') to watch the sunset over Paleokastritsa's bays.

stops.title: The wall climb in the cool
stops.desc: Take the 1,350 steps in the morning air: a breather at the Church of Our Lady of Remedy, the flag at the top and the whole bay below. Half a...

stops.title: The Old Town labyrinth
stops.desc: The cathedral, the Maritime Museum and a square coffee; greetings to the cats, five minutes for the Cats Museum. As the crowds build, you dr...

stops.title: Escape to Perast
stops.desc: 25 minutes on the Blue Line bus: walk the single street, cross by skiff to Our Lady of the Rocks, see the church's silver votives.

stops.title: A swimming break in the bay
stops.desc: Slip into the sea from the jetties of Perast or Dobrota: swimming in glassy water in the mountain's shadow is the day's reward.

stops.title: Sunset on the Muo quay
stops.desc: Walk to the far shore or take a short taxi: the walls' reflection in the water and the lights coming on one by one — have your camera ready.

stops.title: A konoba evening
stops.desc: Buzara mussels + the day's fish + Vranac: on the quay or in a back lane, unhurried. Whether the night ends with square music is your call.

stops.title: The morning sea
stops.desc: The first swim in the main cove while the water is glass: sunbeds empty, light soft. Breakfast of byrek + coffee from the shore bakery.

stops.title: The islands by kayak
stops.desc: Rent a kayak and round the four islands cove by cove: land on a deserted pebble strip, snorkel the rocks.

stops.title: A mussel table
stops.desc: Lunch on the lagoon side: steamed Butrint mussels + grilled fish + a cold white. Avash avash — no hurry.

stops.title: The stones of Butrint
stops.desc: Ten minutes down the road and two thousand years back: the theatre, the mosaics and the Venetian tower over the lagoon. The forest's shade i...

stops.title: The Lëkurësi sunset
stops.desc: Up to the castle: as bay, headland and Corfu turn orange, raise your glass — you're on the riviera's best balcony.

stops.title: An evening on the shore
stops.desc: Dinner at a fish restaurant in the centre, then a slow close in the beach bars: a Ksamil night is calm and starry.

stops.title: St. Thomas Church (Thomaskirche) & Bach Monument
stops.desc: Pay respects at J.S. Bach's tomb in the choir, view the stained-glass windows, and visit the Bach Museum across the courtyard.

stops.title: St. Nicholas Church (Nikolaikirche)
stops.desc: Marvel at the neoclassical palm-tree columns and learn how Monday peace prayers sparked the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989.

stops.title: Mädler-Passage & Historic Arcades
stops.desc: Stroll beneath the glass skylights, touch the Faust and Mephistopheles bronze statues, and admire luxury boutiques.

stops.title: Historic Lunch in Auerbachs Keller
stops.desc: Descend into the 1525 historic vaulted cellar for Saxon Sauerbraten or Leipziger Allerlei where Goethe dined as a student.

stops.title: Afternoon Pastry at Cafe Kandler
stops.desc: Enjoy a fresh almond-marzipan Leipziger Lerche pastry with hot coffee right next to Thomaskirche.

stops.title: Völkerschlachtdenkmal (Battle of the Nations Monument)
stops.desc: Take tram 15 to the monumental 91-meter stone colossus and climb to the outdoor viewing platform over Leipzig.

stops.title: Evening Craft Beer at Bayerischer Bahnhof
stops.desc: Head to Germany's oldest preserved train station to taste fresh sour Gose beer and hearty brewery classics.

stops.title: Alfama morning
stops.desc: Climb the narrow lanes: washing lines, azulejo façades, fado drifting from a corner. Coffee break at Miradouro da Graça.

stops.title: São Jorge Castle or the cathedral
stops.desc: From the castle the city lies tile by tile at your feet; if the queue is long, the cathedral + the Portas do Sol view will do.

stops.title: Lunch at a tasca
stops.desc: The fish of the day, a jug of vinho da casa; the bill surprisingly small, the satisfaction large.

stops.title: Chiado + Bica
stops.desc: Browse Bertrand (the world's oldest bookshop), then descend the slopes beside the Bica funicular.

stops.title: Cacilhas ferry
stops.desc: Cross the river and watch Lisbon at sunset from the far bank; the return ferry is the city's cheapest scenic cruise.

stops.title: Bairro Alto evening
stops.desc: Tiny bars, glasses on the street, fado leaking from somewhere; the night here is best unplanned.

stops.title: Full English breakfast
stops.desc: Start the day somewhere like the Regency Cafe: once, done properly.

stops.title: Westminster + South Bank walk
stops.desc: See Big Ben and Parliament, cross the bridge, walk the river to Tate Modern. The city's best free tour.

stops.title: Lunch at Borough Market
stops.desc: Stall by stall, eating as you go. Come on a weekday to dodge the Saturday crush.

stops.title: Pick one museum
stops.desc: British Museum, National Gallery or Tate — all free. Choose one, give it two hours, thank yourself on the way out.

stops.title: Pub hour
stops.desc: Live the after-work pub ritual: pint in hand on the pavement, noise, chatter. Ye Olde Cheshire Cheese is a historic place to start.

stops.title: Sunset at Sky Garden or Primrose Hill
stops.desc: In the glass garden with a free booking, or on the grass at the top of the hill: London at your feet.

stops.title: Venice morning
stops.desc: Watch the surfers while the boardwalk wakes, then turn into the canals: Venice's two faces in morning calm.

stops.title: The beach bike ride
stops.desc: Pedal the Strand to Santa Monica: ocean on your left, palms on your right. The Ferris wheel photo at the pier is the classic.

stops.title: Fish taco lunch
stops.desc: Baja-style crisp fish tacos with lime and cabbage: the beach day's undisputed lunch.

stops.title: DTLA hours
stops.desc: Cross to Downtown on the E line: the Bradbury's light atrium, the Last Bookstore tunnels and a Grand Central Market coffee.

stops.title: Griffith golden hour
stops.desc: Reach the observatory before sunset: the city turns orange with the Hollywood Sign alongside. This is LA's appointed hour.

stops.title: Taco truck night
stops.desc: Stop at the glowing truck on the way home: al pastor 'with everything'. Standing, plate in hand — an LA day closes this way.

stops.title: The Kapellbrücke morning
stops.desc: Walk the bridge while it's empty and take the tower photo; a fresco round of the old squares + a bakery breakfast.

stops.title: The golden round's first leg
stops.desc: Boat to Alpnachstad: lake, coffee and mountain silhouettes on deck. Then climb Pilatus on the world's steepest cog railway.

stops.title: The summit hour
stops.desc: The Pilatus terraces and a short ridge walk: the lake's arms at your feet. Lunch of älplermagronen at the mountain restaurant.

stops.title: Cable car down + back to town
stops.desc: Glide down to Kriens and bus back to the centre; stop at the Lion Monument — better in the afternoon lull.

stops.title: The Musegg wall
stops.desc: Climb the towers and gather the lake-city-mountain panorama; a chocolate break in the old town on the way down.

stops.title: A quay evening
stops.desc: A sunset walk on the Nationalquai, then a Chügelipastete or lake-fish dinner: a glass of white, Pilatus lighting up across the water.

stops.title: Croix-Rousse market
stops.desc: Cheese and fruit at the hilltop morning market; coffee on the square, catching the village rhythm of the silk-weavers' quarter.

stops.title: The traboule descent
stops.desc: Start at the Cour des Voraces and drop down the slope through hidden passages: every door a surprise, every courtyard a century.

stops.title: Lunch at a bouchon
stops.desc: At your reserved table: quenelle or tablier de sapeur, Beaujolais by the pot. Hurrying forbidden.

stops.title: Vieux Lyon + the cathedral
stops.desc: Walk the Renaissance lanes, enter Saint-Jean with its astronomical clock; an ice-cream stop is permitted.

stops.title: Funicular to Fourvière
stops.desc: From the basilica's terrace, the two-rivered city lies at your feet; make the descent through the Roman theatres.

stops.title: Evening on the Rhône quay
stops.desc: A glass on the river barges, then dinner on the Presqu'île; let the table run long — Lyon likes it that way.

stops.title: The Prado — first hour
stops.desc: Book ahead and meet Velázquez and Goya with a fresh head; two hours is enough — don't attempt it all.

stops.title: Retiro Park
stops.desc: The Crystal Palace, a rowboat on the pond, or simply sun on a bench: where Madrid breathes.

stops.title: Long lunch in La Latina
stops.desc: Bar to bar along Cava Baja: huevos rotos, tortilla, a glass of vermut. Hurrying is forbidden.

stops.title: Malasaña + Chueca crawl
stops.desc: Vintage shops, record stores, third-wave coffee; Madrid's young heart beats in these two quarters.

stops.title: Sunset on the Círculo rooftop
stops.desc: Look down Gran Vía from the Círculo de Bellas Artes terrace: the city's lights switch on at exactly this hour.

stops.title: Churros at San Ginés
stops.desc: Dipping churros in thick hot chocolate at midnight is Madrid's closing ritual; the queue moves fast.

stops.title: Alcazaba & Roman Theatre
stops.desc: Climb through bougainvillea gardens and Moorish courtyards of the 11th-century palace fortress.

stops.title: Picasso Museum & Cathedral
stops.desc: Admire Picasso's paintings in Palacio de Buenavista, then visit the Renaissance Cathedral.

stops.title: Tapas Lunch at Mercado de Atarazanas
stops.desc: Sample grilled skewers and fresh fried boquerones under the Moorish stained-glass window.

stops.title: Muelle Uno Promenade & Centre Pompidou
stops.desc: Stroll past yachts along the palm-lined harbor and take photos by the colorful glass cube.

stops.title: Sunset Espetos at Pedregalejo Beach
stops.desc: Take bus 34 to Pedregalejo to watch sardines roasting over embers in wooden boats at sunset.

stops.title: Antigua Casa de Guardia & Soho Tapas
stops.desc: Asırlık fıçıdan tatlı Málaga şarabı yudumlama ve Soho mahallesinde leziz Gambas al Pil-Pil ziyafeti.

stops.title: Palma Cathedral (La Seu)
stops.desc: The Gothic giant by the sea is at its best in morning light; look for Gaudí's touches inside.

stops.title: Old town + ensaimada break
stops.desc: Get lost among the courtyard mansions; ensaimada and hot chocolate the century-old way at Ca'n Joan de S'Aigo.

stops.title: Board the Sóller train
stops.desc: In wooden carriages from 1912 into the orange valley: through mountain tunnels, alighting on Sóller's square.

stops.title: Tram to Port de Sóller
stops.desc: The nostalgic tram rolls down to the harbour; lunch by the water, the day's fish on the plate.

stops.title: Coastal drive to Deià
stops.desc: Along the serpentine road to the Tramuntana's loveliest village: stone houses, an artists' soul, olive terraces.

stops.title: Sunset and evening
stops.desc: In Deià, or back in Palma's Santa Catalina quarter: tapas, island wine, long conversation.

stops.title: Majorelle at opening
stops.desc: Be first into the cobalt garden; then a short dive into the YSL museum. You're out before the crowds are in.

stops.title: The Koutoubia and into the medina
stops.desc: Walk from the minaret's shadow to the ramparts and enter the medina by the Kasbah gate: the Saadian tombs' tiled chambers are still calm.

stops.title: A tanjia lunch
stops.desc: Tip the ash-cooked tanjia from its urn onto the plate: Marrakech's signature meal. Mint tea on top, half an hour in the shade.

stops.title: The souk and Le Jardin Secret
stops.desc: Get lost in the spice pyramids and the leather and copper veins; when tired, breathe in the secret garden's water-channelled courtyard.

stops.title: Sunset tea on a terrace
stops.desc: Climb to the Maison de la Photographie's roof: sip tea as the medina rooftops turn red — below, the square is already assembling.

stops.title: A Jemaa el-Fnaa night
stops.desc: Smoke, drums, story circles and the hundred-stall kitchen: dinner at a crowded stall, then lose yourself in the square's theatre.

stops.title: Vieux-Port fish market
stops.desc: Watch fish go from boat to stall on the quay; the market ends at 10:00, come early.

stops.title: The lanes of Le Panier
stops.desc: Get lost in the city's oldest quarter: street art, washing lines, the calm courtyard of the Vieille Charité.

stops.title: Lunch in Noailles
stops.desc: Among the stalls of 'the belly of Marseille': panisse, kebab, North African aromas. The city's true seasoning.

stops.title: MuCEM + Cathédrale de la Major
stops.desc: From the lace-concrete museum, stretch over the sea by footbridge; the striped cathedral is lovely while waiting for dusk.

stops.title: Notre-Dame de la Garde
stops.desc: Climb the hill and watch city and sea from under La Bonne Mère: Marseille's best view, free.

stops.title: Evening on Cours Julien
stops.desc: A bar on the graffiti-covered square, live music, pastis. The night stretches long here.

stops.title: Bakery breakfast — Piano
stops.desc: Warm focaccia and coffee to start; take your first look at the Sassi from Piazza Vittorio Veneto.

stops.title: Casa Noha — learn the story
stops.desc: Watch Matera's journey from shame to UNESCO in a 25-minute film; calibrate your eyes.

stops.title: Descend Sasso Barisano
stops.desc: Wind down the stone lanes: cave courtyards, bell towers, cistern mouths. A short dive into the Palombaro Lungo.

stops.title: Lunch in a cave trattoria
stops.desc: Cavatelli con cruschi + a glass of Aglianico; unhurried beneath the cool stone.

stops.title: Caveoso and the rock churches
stops.desc: Climb to Madonna de Idris, see the old cave-house life at the Casa Grotta; walk the canyon's edge.

stops.title: Murgia Timone sunset
stops.desc: Cross the suspension bridge to the far slope: the Sassi blush head-on. Return by torchlight, dinner in a stone lane.

stops.title: South Beach morning
stops.desc: Swim while the beach is empty and the light soft; then shoot Ocean Drive's art deco facades without the crowds.

stops.title: The art deco walk
stops.desc: A pastel architecture tour via Española Way and Lincoln Road: facades, neon signs and shaded arcades.

stops.title: Little Havana lunch
stops.desc: A Cubano on Calle Ocho, cafecito at a ventanita, the masters at Domino Park: Miami's heart lives in this triangle.

stops.title: The Wynwood walls
stops.desc: A gallery-and-mural tour of the district: a different artist at every corner. The side streets outgive the main courtyard.

stops.title: Sunset on the bay
stops.desc: Board a Bayside boat tour or sit on the Brickell riverside: the skyline turns neon in golden light.

stops.title: Salsa night
stops.desc: Live Latin music in Little Havana or Brickell: mojito, ropa vieja and the dance floor. Dale — the night doesn't end early in Miami.

stops.title: Mytilene bazaar and castle
stops.desc: Walk the Ermou street bazaar, look over the harbour from the Byzantine-Ottoman castle walls; coffee at an old bazaar kafeneio.

stops.title: North road — Kalloni stop
stops.desc: Head for Molyvos; break early at a bay taverna in Kalloni for sardines + ouzo. In season, spot the flamingos on the salt pans.

stops.title: The lanes of Molyvos
stops.desc: Climb between stone mansions to the castle: whitewash, bougainvillea and the gulf below. The island's most beautiful half hour is this slope...

stops.title: Hot spring + sea at Eftalou
stops.desc: Warm up in the bathhouse's 43 degrees, dive into the Aegean two steps away; repeat. Island therapy in summary.

stops.title: Sunset at Molyvos harbour
stops.desc: Grilled octopus at a harbour taverna, ouzo on ice and the sinking sun; whoever hurries, loses.

stops.title: Return or stay
stops.desc: The night road back to Mytilene takes an hour; the wise traveller booked a room in Molyvos.

stops.title: Duomo + rooftop terraces
stops.desc: The cathedral first, then up to the roof: walking among marble spires is Milan's finest moment. Book ahead.

stops.title: Galleria + La Scala
stops.desc: Pass through the Galleria (spin on the bull!), emerge at La Scala. The museum is short and sweet if you want a peek inside.

stops.title: Lunch in Brera
stops.desc: A trattoria in the painters' quarter; then a quick look into the Pinacoteca di Brera.

stops.title: The Last Supper (with reservation)
stops.desc: If you booked months ago, this is your slot. If not, don't grieve: the bone chapel of San Bernardino alle Ossa is an unforgettable plan B.

stops.title: Sforza Castle + Parco Sempione
stops.desc: Through the castle courtyard into the park; breathe green alongside the Milanese.

stops.title: Aperitivo on the Navigli
stops.desc: Campari or spritz by the canal, the plate that comes with it is your dinner. The peak of the Milanese ritual.

stops.title: Traditional Breakfast at Viktualienmarkt
stops.desc: Start with fresh pretzels and hot coffee or a traditional Weißwurst breakfast under the chestnut trees.

stops.title: Marienplatz & Glockenspiel Show
stops.desc: Watch the 43 bells and 32 dancing figures reenact royal tournaments from the New Town Hall facade.

stops.title: Frauenkirche & Alter Peter Tower
stops.desc: Admire the Devil's Footstep inside Frauenkirche, then climb Alter Peter for breathtaking views across red rooftops.

stops.title: Eisbach River Surfers & Englischer Garten
stops.desc: Stroll through the Hofgarten to watch daring surfers ride the Eisbach standing wave, then walk to the Chinese Tower.

stops.title: Beer Garden Break at Chinesischer Turm
stops.desc: Enjoy an authentic Maß of beer and hot Obatzda while a traditional Bavarian brass band plays from the wooden pagoda.

stops.title: Dinner at a Historic Brewery
stops.desc: Finish the day with crispy Schweinshaxe and live oompah folk music at Augustiner Großgaststätte.

stops.title: Chora — before the crowds
stops.desc: Get lost in the white labyrinth: bougainvillea, cats and boutiques not yet open. The best photos happen now.

stops.title: Paraportiani + the old port
stops.desc: The white miracle of five churches melted into one; then the fishermen and the heirs of Petros the pelican.

stops.title: Escape to Agios Sostis
stops.desc: The sea in the north's untouched cove: no club, no umbrella, pure Aegean.

stops.title: Lunch — a Kiki's-style taverna
stops.desc: Grilled octopus, horiatiki, cold white wine; no electricity, no hurry, plenty of flavour.

stops.title: Ano Mera pause
stops.desc: A monastery courtyard and a square coffee in the island's inland village; island life, not a tourist window.

stops.title: Sunset at the windmills
stops.desc: Sit on the wall before Kato Mili as the sun drops into the Aegean; then a glass in Little Venice and dinner in Chora.

stops.title: Walk Spaccanapoli
stops.desc: Follow the line that splits the city: churches, presepe workshops, life hanging from balconies. Morning coffee standing at Gambrinus.

stops.title: Cappella Sansevero
stops.desc: The Veiled Christ's miracle in marble; book ahead, hold your breath inside.

stops.title: Pizza — the real one
stops.desc: Margherita or marinara, 90 seconds in a wood oven. Hold it by the crust, fold, eat with gratitude.

stops.title: Toledo metro + Quartieri Spagnoli
stops.desc: Surface from Europe's most beautiful metro station and dive into the Spanish Quarter's narrow vertical lanes: murals, the Maradona shrine, t...

stops.title: Castel Sant'Elmo sunset
stops.desc: Take the funicular up to Vomero: from the castle walls, the bay, Vesuvius, and the city simmering below.

stops.title: Chiaia evening
stops.desc: Aperitivo in the seaside quarter, then ragù or seafood; close with a sfogliatella.

stops.title: Central Park morning
stops.desc: Walk Bethesda Terrace and The Mall with the joggers; the park belongs to New Yorkers in the morning and tourists by day.

stops.title: Met or MoMA — choose one
stops.desc: They don't fit in one day. Choose, give it two hours; walk Fifth Avenue on the way out.

stops.title: A slice or pastrami
stops.desc: A slice at Joe's or pastrami on rye at Katz's: both standing, both legend.

stops.title: High Line + Chelsea Market
stops.desc: Walk the old rail line, snack in the market below; carry on to the glass of Hudson Yards.

stops.title: Sunset on the Brooklyn Bridge
stops.desc: Enter from the Manhattan side and walk to DUMBO: as the sun drops, the city behind you turns into a postcard.

stops.title: West Village evening
stops.desc: A bistro on the tree-lined streets, then a jazz club. The New York night writes itself.

stops.title: Cours Saleya market
stops.desc: Walk among flower and fruit stalls; local fruit and an espresso count as breakfast.

stops.title: The lanes of Vieux Nice
stops.desc: Get lost in the narrow streets: gelato on Place Rossetti, baroque churches, light between the washing lines.

stops.title: Socca break
stops.desc: Hot socca from the wood oven + a glass of cold rosé. Nice's most honest lunch.

stops.title: Colline du Château
stops.desc: Walk up (the lift doesn't count): the waterfall, the ceramic viewpoint and the best photo of the city.

stops.title: Sea hour
stops.desc: Towel on the pebbles, dive into the Mediterranean. Feeling brave? Head toward Coco Beach and swim with the locals.

stops.title: Promenade sunset + dinner
stops.desc: Sunset from the famous blue chairs, then a Vieux Nice bistro: pissaladière, daube, a glass of Bellet.

stops.title: Kaiserburg Imperial Castle & Ramparts
stops.desc: Climb up to the castle courtyard, peer down the 50-meter Deep Well, and take in the panoramic red-roof vista.

stops.title: Albrecht Dürer's House & Tiergärtnertor
stops.desc: Tour the 1420 half-timbered home and workshop where Dürer created his famous woodcuts and copperplate engravings.

stops.title: Wander Picturesque Weißgerbergasse
stops.desc: Photograph Germany's most beautiful ensemble of restored medieval craftsmen's half-timbered houses.

stops.title: Beechwood Bratwurst Lunch at Bratwursthäusle
stops.desc: Order six beechwood-grilled sausages on a pewter plate with warm potato salad and a glass of fresh Rotbier.

stops.title: Hauptmarkt & Schöner Brunnen Ring
stops.desc: Spin the golden ring for good luck, admire the Gothic facade of Frauenkirche, and sample fresh gingerbread.

stops.title: Henkersteg Bridge & Pegnitz Riverside
stops.desc: Walk across the wooden executioner's footbridge, take photos of the Weinstadel, and enjoy coffee on Trödelmarkt island.

stops.title: Tour the Felsengänge Rock Cellars
stops.desc: Descend into the underground cellars beneath Altstadthof and sample traditional distilled beer spirits.

stops.title: Dinner at Albrecht-Dürer-Stube
stops.desc: Savor crispy roasted Franconian Schäufele with dark beer sauce and potato dumplings in an intimate historic tavern.

stops.title: Morning on the opera roof
stops.desc: Walk the marble slope to the roof: the fjord, the islands and the waking city beneath you. Morning light is at its best on the white marble.

stops.title: Munch or the National Museum
stops.desc: Face the Scream: the Munch museum neighbours the opera, the National Museum sits by the harbour. Choose one — both don't fit in a morning.

stops.title: Harbour promenade + shrimp
stops.desc: Walk the Havnepromenaden past Akershus Fortress to Aker Brygge; a fresh shrimp + baguette break on the pier.

stops.title: Vigeland Park
stops.desc: Tram 12 to Frogner: the human condition in more than 200 sculptures — the photo with the Angry Boy is the classic. The park is free and alwa...

stops.title: A Grünerløkka pause
stops.desc: Descend along the Akerselva into the neighbourhood: third-wave coffee or an early beer, vintage windows, the sound of the river.

stops.title: A fjord close at Sørenga
stops.desc: A courage lap at the swimming pier, or just feet dangling; dinner in Bjørvika — as the Barcode lights fall onto the water.

stops.title: Breakfast at Ballarò market
stops.desc: Shouting vendors (the abbanniata), smoking stalls: start the day with a hot panelle sandwich.

stops.title: Cappella Palatina
stops.desc: The golden-mosaic miracle of the Norman palace — book ahead, and let your neck ache from staring at the ceiling.

stops.title: Cathedral + Quattro Canti
stops.desc: From the cathedral's mixed genius to the baroque crossroads; four corners, four seasons, four saints.

stops.title: Lunch — arancina and pasta alla Norma
stops.desc: An arancina at somewhere like Ke Palle, or Norma at a trattoria; espresso standing.

stops.title: Santa Caterina monastery
stops.desc: Sweets made to the nuns' secret recipes (I Segreti del Chiostro) + the city from the rooftop terrace.

stops.title: Vucciria night
stops.desc: The daytime market square becomes an open-air bar: grill smoke, cheap wine, loud life.

stops.title: Bakery breakfast
stops.desc: A croissant and the tip of a baguette from a neighbourhood boulangerie; coffee at the counter. Start the day Parisian.

stops.title: Île de la Cité + Sainte-Chapelle
stops.desc: Notre-Dame's square, then the stained-glass miracle of Sainte-Chapelle. Book ahead, enter in morning light.

stops.title: Lunch in the Marais
stops.desc: Falafel or bistro? Both are Marais classics. Then the boutiques and Place des Vosges.

stops.title: Louvre or Orsay — choose one
stops.desc: Cramming both into one day kills both. Choose, give it two hours, leave.

stops.title: Palais Royal + coffee break
stops.desc: Breathe in the colonnaded garden, pass through Galerie Vivienne, take a window seat in a café.

stops.title: Seine sunset + evening
stops.desc: A wine-and-cheese picnic on the quay, or steak frites at a bistro. Finale: catch the Eiffel sparkling on the hour.

stops.title: The Rocky steps and museum morning
stops.desc: Run the steps and strike the victory pose on an empty plaza; at this hour there's no statue queue.

stops.title: Independence Hall and the Liberty Bell
stops.desc: See the signing room with your timed ticket, then face the bell's crack: America's birth certificates on one square.

stops.title: Elfreth's Alley and Old City
stops.desc: Walk America's oldest street and browse the gallery windows: brick Philly's most graceful corner.

stops.title: Reading Terminal lunch
stops.desc: A crawl of the market stalls: the roast pork sandwich or an Amish breakfast. Claiming a table is a sport; the atmosphere is the prize.

stops.title: Magic Gardens and South Street
stops.desc: Get lost in the mosaic labyrinth, then continue through South Street's shops: Philly's most colorful face.

stops.title: Cheesesteak and river night
stops.desc: Take the 'whiz wit' exam at a neighborhood counter; close with the Boathouse Row lights reflected on the river.

stops.title: São Bento + pastel de nata
stops.desc: See the station's tiled hall while it's empty; start the day at the corner bakery with a hot nata + galão.

stops.title: The cathedral and the upper town
stops.desc: A first river view from the Sé's terrace; descend the narrow lanes to the Vitória miradouro and meet the city from above.

stops.title: The francesinha mission

stops.title: Ribeira and the bridge crossing
stops.desc: Coffee on the coloured quay, then walk the Dom Luís I upper deck to Gaia: the river beneath your feet, the skyline before you.

stops.title: A lodge tasting

stops.title: Evening in Baixa
stops.desc: Bacalhau or a petiscos crawl at a tasca; afterwards the bars of the Galerias de Paris street — a Porto night starts modestly and ends late.

stops.title: Charles Bridge — early
stops.desc: Before 8 the bridge is yours: mist, statues and empty stones. The most magical half hour of the day.

stops.title: Prague Castle + St. Vitus
stops.desc: Walk up, take in the cathedral's stained glass, watch the city from the castle courtyards. Come down before the crowds.

stops.title: Lunch in Malá Strana
stops.desc: Pass through the Wallenstein Garden (greet the peacocks), then svíčková and beer at a hospoda.

stops.title: Old Town + the clock
stops.desc: See the Astronomical Clock once (that's enough), then escape the square: the lanes behind Týn and Nový Svět are far more beautiful.

stops.title: Náplavka embankment
stops.desc: Walk the Vltava, watch the swans, a beer from a riverside bar. If it's Saturday, the farmers' market is a bonus.

stops.title: Hospoda evening
stops.desc: Shoulder to shoulder with locals at a beer hall like U Zlatého Tygra: the beer arrives unasked, the conversation starts itself.

stops.title: Old Town — before the crowds
stops.desc: Walk the Street of the Knights to the Palace of the Grand Master; the stone is cool, the lanes empty.

stops.title: Palace and walls
stops.desc: The palace courtyard and mosaics, then the wall walk (on open days): tiled roofs and two harbours from above.

stops.title: Road to Lindos
stops.desc: 50 minutes by bus or car; a quick look at the Kallithea thermal cove on the way is allowed.

stops.title: Lindos lunch + acropolis
stops.desc: A light lunch in the village, then the climb: St Paul's Bay through the columns — the island's most famous frame.

stops.title: Sea break
stops.desc: Swim at Lindos main beach or St Paul's Bay; the afternoon light turns the bay deep green.

stops.title: Mandraki evening
stops.desc: Back in town, walk the promenade between the deer statues; open dinner at an ouzeri with pitaroudia.

stops.title: Colosseum — first slot
stops.desc: Book weeks ahead, walk in as the gates open: the arena in morning light, without the crowds, is another place.

stops.title: Forum + Palatine
stops.desc: Walk through the heart of the empire. No rushing; getting lost among the stones is the itinerary.

stops.title: Lunch in Monti
stops.desc: Two streets from the Colosseum: cacio e pepe or pizza al taglio. Espresso at the counter, standing.

stops.title: Pantheon + Navona
stops.desc: Watch the light through the oculus, then a lap of Navona; no sitting down, gelato in hand.

stops.title: Trevi + Spanish Steps at sunset
stops.desc: Toss a coin over your shoulder at Trevi, then golden hour on the Steps.

stops.title: Trastevere evening
stops.desc: Cross the river, find a back-street trattoria: carbonara, house wine, long conversation. This is how Rome ends.

stops.title: Breakfast + layer up
stops.desc: A solid breakfast in the centre, three layers of clothing on top: you're mostly outdoors today. Don't forget to fill the thermos.

stops.title: Santa Claus Village
stops.desc: Bus 8 to the village: take a real step across the Arctic Circle line, collect your certificate, chat with Santa and post your card with the ...

stops.title: Back to town + lounas
stops.desc: A lunch menu in the centre: salmon soup + rye bread. Then a short loop around Lordi Square and a look at the souvenirs.

stops.title: Sauna + avanto courage
stops.desc: Warm up in a hotel or public sauna; if you dare, one dip in the ice hole. For dinner, poronkäristys — seal the day Lapland-style.

stops.title: The aurora hunt

stops.title: Port and La Ponche morning

stops.title: Climb to the Citadelle
stops.desc: From the 16th-century fort the gulf lies at your feet; the maritime museum inside tells the village's real story.

stops.title: Place des Lices
stops.desc: If it's Tuesday or Saturday, the market feast; if not, watch pétanque under the plane trees and buy the tarte Tropézienne at its source.

stops.title: Lunch — Place aux Herbes
stops.desc: The little square's fish stall and bistros: the day's catch, a glass of rosé.

stops.title: Pampelonne or the coastal path
stops.desc: Either the sea on the public beach, or cove-to-cove walking on the Sentier du Littoral.

stops.title: Sunset in Gassin
stops.desc: From the hill village's terrace the gulf turns crimson; dinner on the village square, with daube.

stops.title: The La Concha paseo
stops.desc: A morning walk on the white-balustraded promenade: the bay calm, the light soft. Enter the old town past the city hall and drink your coffee...

stops.title: The Urgull climb
stops.desc: Up the path on the hill behind the old town: ramparts, the statue and the bay from above. Descend by the Paseo Nuevo corniche — the waves ke...

stops.title: The first pintxo crawl
stops.desc: Open with a gilda, join the tortilla watch, order a gem from the hot list: three bars, three specialities, a zurito and a txakoli alongside.

stops.title: Ondarreta and the Peine del Viento

stops.title: The California line cable car

stops.title: Dim sum in Chinatown
stops.desc: Steaming baskets in America's oldest Chinatown: char siu bao for breakfast, then a walk down Grant Avenue.

stops.title: North Beach and City Lights
stops.desc: Dive into the beat generation's bookstore, take an espresso break on Washington Square: the Italian quarter's calm hour.

stops.title: The Wharf and Musée Mécanique
stops.desc: Watch the sea lions, play the coin machines, drink a chowder bowl facing the bay.

stops.title: Walk or pedal to the bridge
stops.desc: Head from Crissy Field toward the bridge on foot or by bike: look up at the steel span from beneath, at Fort Point.

stops.title: Mission night
stops.desc: A late tour of the mural alleys, then a super burrito and a neighborhood bar: close the day in the city's sunniest quarter.

stops.title: Oia — before the crowds
stops.desc: Blue domes, windmills and empty lanes: shoot the island's postcard in the morning's golden light.

stops.title: Down to Ammoudi
stops.desc: Take the steps down to the red-cliffed port; fishing boats and morning coffee, and a swim off the rocks if you like.

stops.title: Ancient Akrotiri
stops.desc: Descend to 1600 BC in the ash-buried Minoan town; read the island's real story under the cool roof.

stops.title: Vineyard lunch + tasting
stops.desc: A light lunch in wine country: fava, tomatokeftedes and two glasses of Assyrtiko. Don't leave without seeing the kouloura vines.

stops.title: Village pause in Pyrgos
stops.desc: Walk the kastelli lanes, look from the hilltop over both seas; coffee on the village square.

stops.title: Sunset — outside Oia
stops.desc: Sit on stone at Skaros or the Akrotiri lighthouse; as the sun drops into the caldera, keep your glass full and your surroundings calm.

stops.title: Buregdžinica breakfast
stops.desc: Burek off the morning tray, yoghurt on top: start the day the Bosnian way. The scent of hot somun from the bakery next door — don't resist.

stops.title: Baščaršija and Kazandžiluk

stops.title: The century walk
stops.desc: Walk Ferhadija east to west: stop at the 'Meeting of Cultures' line on the pavement, then take a coffee break on the cathedral square.

stops.title: Ćevapi noon
stops.desc: Five ćevapi with kajmak and onion at a bazaar ćevabdžinica: drinking yoghurt alongside. Simple, smoky, beyond debate.

stops.title: Latin Bridge and museums
stops.desc: Stand at Franz Ferdinand's corner where world history turned; then the Siege Museum or Svrzo House — whichever century you choose.

stops.title: Žuta Tabija sunset

stops.title: Castello morning

stops.title: San Benedetto market
stops.desc: Descend to the fish floor of one of Italy's biggest covered markets: bottarga, cheese and provisions for lunch.

stops.title: South to the Chia coves
stops.desc: Drive the coast road to Chia: turquoise water, white dunes, a flamingo lagoon. Swim at Su Giudeu.

stops.title: Lunch behind the beach
stops.desc: Fregola or a panino at a sand-floored chiringuito; then one more cove — Tuerredda if you dare, check its quota.

stops.title: Ancient Nora
stops.desc: Stop at the seaside Phoenician-Roman city on the way back: mosaics, theatre and the setting sun in one frame.

stops.title: Cagliari evening
stops.desc: A seafood table in the Marina quarter, closed with mirto. Ajò — another cove tomorrow!

stops.title: Pike Place at setup
stops.desc: Enter as the stalls assemble: fish throwing, flower towers and the first piroshky. Take your coffee from an independent roaster.

stops.title: The waterfront and the aquarium
stops.desc: Descend the market stairs to the shore: walk the new promenade, and drop in on the sea otters if you like.

stops.title: Teriyaki or chowder lunch
stops.desc: A set meal at a neighborhood teriyaki joint or a chowder cup at the market: Seattle's everyday flavor.

stops.title: Seattle Center and the music museum
stops.desc: Monorail to Seattle Center: MoPOP's guitar tower and grunge memory, or Chihuly's glass garden — your choice.

stops.title: The Kerry Park frame
stops.desc: Climb Queen Anne: the Needle, the skyline and, with luck, Rainier. The city's postcard is taken from this terrace.

stops.title: The Bainbridge ferry sunset
stops.desc: Walk on and take the deck: a golden skyline going out, city lights coming home. Close with a Downtown oyster happy hour.

stops.title: Bougatsa morning
stops.desc: Hot cream bougatsa from the bakery, cinnamon on top: first coffee alongside. You've started the day Thessaloniki-style.

stops.title: Waterfront and the White Tower

stops.title: Market lunch at Kapani
stops.desc: A taverna table among the market stalls: the day's fish, fava, a small tsipouro. Thessaloniki's most honest noon.

stops.title: The Byzantine and Roman layer
stops.desc: The crypt silence of Agios Dimitrios, then the gold mosaics of the Rotunda: two buildings, seventeen centuries.

stops.title: Ano Poli and Trigonion sunset

stops.title: Ladadika evening
stops.desc: The meze order on the taverna lanes: octopus, horta, a carafe of wine. The closing volta on the waterfront — with the lights on the water.

stops.title: Gyeongbokgung and the guard ceremony

stops.title: Bukchon and Ikseondong
stops.desc: Roof curves on the hanok village slopes, then Ikseondong's cafe lanes: two hours where tradition and today shake hands.

stops.title: Gwangjang Market lunch
stops.desc: Grab a stool for bindaetteok and mayak gimbap: the aunties' stall mastery is the show itself.

stops.title: Cheonggyecheon and Dongdaemun
stops.desc: Walk the stream to the spaceship architecture of the DDP: Zaha Hadid's curves are at their best at sunset.

stops.title: The Naksan wall walk
stops.desc: Climb to the walls from Hyehwa: as the lights come on, the city spreads at your feet. Seoul's most romantic free hour.

stops.title: Samgyeopsal and the night streets
stops.desc: The wrap ritual around the coals, then Hongdae's street performances or a pojangmacha stall: the night doesn't end early in Seoul.

stops.title: Real Alcázar — first slot
stops.desc: Book weeks ahead and take the first entry: the gardens in the morning cool, before the crowds, are paradise itself.

stops.title: Cathedral + Giralda
stops.desc: The world's largest Gothic cathedral, then climb the ramped tower: Seville at your feet.

stops.title: Long lunch + siesta
stops.desc: Match the city's rhythm: salmorejo, espinacas, a glass of fino. Then no hurry — the hottest hours pass in the shade.

stops.title: Plaza de España + María Luisa Park
stops.desc: Ceramic bridges and the canal in evening light; the city's most generous photo stage.

stops.title: Tapas crawl in Triana
stops.desc: Cross the bridge, go bar to bar around Calle Betis and the market: pescaíto frito + cold beer.

stops.title: Flamenco at night
stops.desc: A small tablao or La Carbonería: the thing they call duende only comes out at this hour.

stops.title: A kopitiam breakfast
stops.desc: Kaya toast + soft eggs + kopi: try the ordering language, and smile if you get it wrong — they'll fix it. Start the day the local way.

stops.title: Chinatown and the temples
stops.desc: Shophouse façades, the Buddha Tooth Relic temple and Sri Mariamman's painted gopuram: three cultures in one quarter.

stops.title: The hawker lunch summit

stops.title: A cool break in the conservatories
stops.desc: Cloud Forest's indoor waterfall and the Flower Dome: the midday heat's most graceful refuge. A bay walk on the way out.

stops.title: The Marina skyline and one cocktail
stops.desc: A one-drink view break at a rooftop bar: watch the skyline light up over the bay — with one drink, the bill stays elegant.

stops.title: Lunch in town + the sweet duel

stops.title: The palace and the changing of the guard
stops.desc: The changing of the guard in the Royal Palace courtyard towards noon; before it, a short dive into one of the palace museums.

stops.title: Fika at Rosendals
stops.desc: Kanelbulle + coffee at Djurgården's garden café: the official fika break among apple trees. Walk back along the water.

stops.title: Södermalm and Monteliusvägen
stops.desc: Browse SoFo's windows, then sunset on the Monteliusvägen path: the city hall tower and Riddarfjärden in golden light.

stops.title: A Söder evening
stops.desc: Köttbullar or modern Swedish cooking, then a microbrewery to close: a Stockholm night starts calm and ends warm.

stops.title: The cathedral — in morning light
stops.desc: See the rose window with the morning sun; if your legs allow, climb the 332 steps to the platform — the Alsatian plain at your feet.

stops.title: The lanes of Petite France
stops.desc: Half-timbered houses along the canal, tanners' roofs, swans; drift between the photo stops.

stops.title: Astronomical clock + lunch
stops.desc: Watch the apostles parade at 12:30, then a round of tarte flambée at a back-street winstub.

stops.title: Barrage Vauban + Ponts Couverts

stops.title: Winstub evening

stops.title: Swabian Lunch at Ochs'n Willi
stops.desc: Savor authentic pan-fried Maultaschen with potato salad or rich cheese Kässpätzle with crispy fried onions.

stops.title: Ride the 'Zacke' Cogwheel Train to Degerloch

stops.title: Walk the Stäffele to Karlshöhe
stops.desc: Descend via historic stone stairways winding between terraced vineyards and forest slopes to the Karlshöhe beer garden.

stops.desc: Finish the evening with a 'Viertele' of regional Trollinger wine and Zwiebelrostbraten in a cozy wood-paneled Weinstube.

stops.desc: The crawl along Fondamenta della Misericordia: cicchetti, spritz (with Select), and feet swinging over the canal.

stops.title: The cathedral and morning streets
stops.desc: See the tiled roof of the Stephansdom in morning light; walk the imperial shopfronts of Graben and Kohlmarkt while they're still empty.

stops.title: Hofburg + Prunksaal
stops.desc: Pass through the palace courtyards, then stand quietly under the dome of the baroque library: Vienna's most concentrated dose of beauty.

stops.title: Lunch at the Naschmarkt
stops.desc: Graze stall by stall, then a sit-down break at a market tavern; if it's Saturday, the flea market is a bonus.

stops.title: Belvedere — Klimt's Kiss
stops.desc: Stand before The Kiss in the Upper Belvedere, then look out over the city from the gardens; your art quota is full for the day.

stops.title: The Ring tour by tram
stops.desc: From the window of tram 2, the parade of Opera, Parliament and Rathaus: at golden hour the palaces turn to light.

stops.title: Coffeehouse + a late-night close
stops.desc: A long coffeehouse sit with Melange and Sachertorte; a Käsekrainer from a Würstelstand on the way home — an imperial day ends with a sausage...

stops.title: Navagio Shipwreck Clifftop Viewpoint
stops.desc: Arrive early at the metal viewing platform to photograph the world-famous shipwreck on the white pebble beach below in calm morning light.

stops.title: Boat Cruise to the Blue Caves
stops.desc: Head down to Porto Vromi or Skinari to board a small boat gliding through natural limestone arches and electric-blue glowing waters.

stops.title: Cliffside Lunch at Porto Limnionas
stops.desc: Savor grilled octopus, Greek village salad with Ladotyri cheese, and cold Verdea wine overlooking the emerald fjord.

stops.title: Swim in Porto Limnionas Fjord
stops.desc: Dive off flat sunbathing rocks into the crystalline, cool waters and snorkel into underwater caverns.

stops.title: Stroll Bochali Hill & Venetian Fortress
stops.desc: Drive up above Zakynthos Town for sweeping panoramic harbor views beneath historic stone pine trees.

stops.title: Romantic Dinner with Kantades Serenades
stops.desc: Dine on traditional beef Sartsa stew in Bochali as local guitarists serenade the moonlit harbor.

stops.title: First train up the Gornergrat
stops.desc: Sit at the right-hand window: the Horu keeps you company all the way. At the top, the glacier amphitheatre and 29 four-thousanders — breakfa...

stops.title: The Riffelsee reflection
stops.desc: Off at Rotenboden and five minutes to the lake: take the mirror shot before the wind rises, then walk the path down to Riffelberg.

stops.title: A hut lunch at Findeln
stops.desc: Cross to the Sunnegga side; rösti + Heida on a Findeln chalet terrace: the view is on the menu.

stops.title: Leisee and the descent
stops.desc: A courage swim or jetty pause at Leisee; descend by funicular or path and pass through the Hinterdorf's barn lane.

stops.title: The alpenglow watch
stops.desc: Take your place at the church bridge: watch the Horu's pink blaze — the village's five quietest minutes.

stops.title: The fondue close
stops.desc: Pot in the middle, Fendant alongside: the day is sealed Valais-style. Don't drop the bread — the forfeit gets discussed at the table.

stops.title: The old town morning
stops.desc: Say good morning to the city from the Lindenhof terrace; see the Chagall windows in their morning blue at the Fraumünster, breakfast in the ...

stops.title: Bahnhofstrasse and the windows
stops.desc: Walk the world's most expensive avenue as a window tour; a Luxemburgerli pause at Sprüngli — leave the box decision for the evening.

stops.title: Noon: river or menu
stops.desc: In summer, a river swim at Letten + the sun deck; otherwise Geschnetzeltes + rösti at a guild restaurant. Both options are local classics.

stops.title: Exploring Zürich West
stops.desc: Tram to Kreis 5: the Im Viadukt arches, Frau Gerold's garden and the galleries — industrial Zurich's new life.

stops.title: Lake boat or badi bar
stops.desc: The small lake circuit on the sunset boat, or an aperitif with feet in the water at the Barfussbar: the glasses rise as the Alps blush.

stops.title: Evening in Niederdorf
stops.desc: Dinner in the narrow lanes, then a glass at Cabaret Voltaire: an absurd and elegant close to the day between the walls where Dada was born.
